Definition: to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lie, tell a lie, be a liar, be found a liar, be in vain, fail; 1a) (Qal) liar (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be proven to be lying; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to lie, tell a lie, tell a lie with, deceive; 1c2) to disappoint, fail; 1d) (Hiphil) to make a liar, prove to be a liar
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
